integrity: The exact generating-function identity is attributed to Wästlund. All-order coefficient positivity and its quantitative bound are established here by a new analytic comparison. Finite exact-arithmetic checks supplement but do not replace the proof. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Three-edge matchings only; independent rate-one exponential edges; m,n >=3; bound not claimed optimal; does not settle k>=4.
title: Quantitative positivity of every cumulant for three-edge exponential matchings
